d:
What happens after death? Josh Gates and spiritual psychic Chip Coffey are going beyond the discovery to find out what they really found. This is a story that does not end when the search does.
In this compilation, they are talking with the dead and asking the question so many people carry in silence: can you speak to the dead? A spiritual medium is opening a door that most people never dare to touch, and what comes through is leaving everyone in the room stunned. Is there an afterlife? The answers are not what anyone expects.
